text:
Kira: OK team 0min sync. We need a short, operationally-safe plan for model catalog cutovers: onboarding guardrails, benchmark hygiene, pin semantics, and an ops canary flow. Customers pushed back on surprise regressions. Can we outline what MVP looks like and owners?

Liam: High-level: (1) onboarding checklist + lightweight bench, (2) explicit pin semantics + exception policy, (3) canary mirror + rollback API. MVP should avoid large infra spends.

Arjun: For benchmarks I vote for stratified 150 samples (gen vs emb) with a fast quality proxy (n-gram overlap for now) and perf metrics (p95 latency, token cost). Run locally on ingest agent or CI to avoid hot infra.

Becky: From CS: customers want clear rollback SLAs and a "migration pause" control. If we give them a 7-day window to opt-out post-cutover (manual rollback), churn drops. They also want comms copy.

Liam: Pin semantics: model pins should be explicit booleans with TTL and an optional exception token. Proposal: pin = {owner, expires_at, exception_reason, fallback_model}. Exception token allows a temporary override for customer-critical traffic with automatic revert on TTL expiry.

Kira: That exception token idea is nice. Ops ask: how does routing behave if fallback_model is missing? Need safe defaults.

Arjun: Default fallback = last-known-stable (the pinned version before cutover). If none, route to cheapest compatible variant. Also add per-request header x-rw-fallback-reason for tracing.

Liam: Canary plan: mirror 1% traffic for 48h, compare quality delta and latency. If quality delta < 1% and latency < 1.5x baseline, escalate to 10% for another 48h, then full flip. Always keep a one-click revert.

Becky: Ops/playbook: CS needs a single-screen action to pause migration, a rollback button, and an automated email template explaining credits/next steps. Also indicate expected customer impact window.

Kira: Ownership: Liam = schema + UX, Arjun = eval harness + sampling tooling, Becky = playbook + customer comms, OpsBot = infra tickets and alerts. Timeline suggestion: two sprints for MVP.

Arjun: Tech notes: we must ingest basic model metadata on upload: tokenizer_hash, avg_seq_len, quantization_hint. Without those sampling will be flaky. I'll add a small validation hook in the upload flow that rejects models missing metadata with clear error text.

Liam: Cost estimates: local CI bench cheap. Mirror-run cost depends on traffic volume; at 1% mirror it's minimal but we need hooks to cap max mirrored QPS per tenant. I'll draft a UI that shows an estimated infra cost range before enabling mirror.

Becky: Billing ask: customers requested temporary credits for mirrored traffic during the trial window. We can do a manual credit for MVP and automate later. Add that to playbook.

Kira: Quality gating decision rules (draft): green = delta <= 0.5% or CI overlaps zero, amber = 0.5% < delta <= 2% (manual review), red = delta > 2% -> roll back. Also require p95 latency not exceed 1.5x. Keep rules configurable per-customer.

Arjun: I'll prototype the sampling notebook and a lightweight stats page showing delta and CI. Scope: one dashboard per migration.

OpsBot: Created infra ticket INF-3301 "catalog canary mirror + rollback API" assigned to @Liam, due 2024-05-02.

Liam: UX: onboarding flow should show a short summary: estimated quality-delta (from sample), estimated infra cost, checkbox to enable auto-mirror, and a note about credits. Keep defaults conservative (mirror off).

Becky: I'll prepare the customer-facing email + rollback command snippets. Also create a support playbook that includes sample language and SLA commitments.

Kira: Decision for MVP: ship onboarding checklist + metadata validation + sampling notebook + quality badge + manual mirror toggle + playbook + manual credits. Defer automated reconciliation and per-tenant configurable thresholds to post-MVP. Everyone ok?

Arjun: OK from evals.

Liam: OK from infra.

Becky: OK from CS.

Kira: Great. We'll reconvene next Tue 11am to review PRs and finalize ship checklist. Thanks :thumbsup:
